title: Cerebus #132 (Jaka's Story 19) - Mar 1990 - Bagged - Aardvark Vanaheim Comics
descriptionText:
This is a rare and collectible comic book titled "Cerebus #132 (Jaka's Story 19)" published by Aardvark-Vanaheim in March 1990. The comic book features the adventures of Cerebus, a unique character created by artist/writer Dave Sim and Gerhard. The comic book is written in English and is a single issue format.

The comic book belongs to the Cerebus universe and is a part of the Copper Age (1984-1991) era. It is a great addition to any comic book collection and a must-have for fans of Cerebus. The comic book is bagged for preservation and is an excellent example of US comics tradition.
